company.name: Listaproperty
company.shortDescription: Lisaproperty is the Middle East and North African (MENA) region's leading real estate portal
company.description:
Listaproperty.com is the first pan-regional real estate portal that connects buyers and renters with sellers and landlords. Our mission is to provide the most integrated and user-friendly marketplace for your real estate needs. We are the first property portal to give homeowners the power to sell their properties directly to buyers or to lease directly to renters, and thus avoiding high agency commission fees. We also work with trusted agents and brokers. As a pan-regional site, we work from Marrakesh to Manama, providing maximum exposure for your properties.

Listaproperty.com seeks to use innovations such as blockchain and artificial intelligence to streamline the property purchase or lease for end-users.


Listaproperty.com was established in 2015. The company was founded by like-minded business partners who had  the vision to create a landing spot that can connect the region's real estate. Together, the partners have more than 15 years of UAE real estate experience, a vast knowledge of consumer trends in the Middle East and international experience in online real estate portals.
